# STR Booster

> STR Booster shares free growth systems for short-term rental hosts and property managers, built on Claude: a nine-step STR AI Journey and free, downloadable Claude skills. Nothing is for sale: no services, no pricing, no affiliate links. Founded by David Anthony Scott. A division of Green Door Hotel Inc.

Key facts:

- What it is: a free, open playbook and skill library for running a short-term rental (vacation rental, Airbnb, Vrbo) business with Claude.
- Who it is for: hosts who run everything themselves, and property managers and co-hosts who want to win more homes.
- Approach: learn the job, systematize it as a Claude skill with your own facts, and never do the same work twice.
- Cost: free. Downloads are ungated. An optional email list sends the full playbook and new skills.
- Founder: David Anthony Scott, 300+ properties optimized, Cornell (eCornell) certificate in hotel real estate investments and asset management, author of Booked Solid.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://strbooster.com/): what STR Booster is and who it is for.
- [The STR AI Journey](https://strbooster.com/playbook): The STR AI Journey is a free, nine-step system for running a short-term rental business with Claude. Each step names one problem, gives you a prompt to copy and a Claude skill to download, and builds on the step before it: set up your business brain first, then brand, guests, listings, channels, marketing, pricing, owners and guest experience.
- [Claude skills](https://strbooster.com/skills): A Claude skill is a small folder of instructions, and sometimes scripts and templates, that teaches Claude to do one job the same way every time. These skills cover short-term rental work such as the business brain, brand guide, guest intelligence report, channel plan, marketing plan and guest experience. They are free and open on GitHub.
- [All skills on GitHub](https://github.com/scottygeneral/strbooster-cohost/tree/main/skills): source for every skill.

## The nine steps

1. [The Brain: Objectives And Strategies](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-1) (45 minutes, once): AI with no goals and no facts gives random answers. Most hosts skip this step, then decide AI does not work.
2. [Brand Building](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-2) (30 minutes): If your listing sounds like every other listing, you compete on price. A clear brand is why a guest books you, and books direct next time.
3. [Know Your Guest](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-3) (20 minutes): You cannot market to everyone. Your reviews already tell you who loves your place most, and why.
4. [Optimize Your Listings](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-4) (15 minutes per listing): Most listings are written for the host, not the guest. The title, first photo and first two lines decide the click.
5. [OTA Distribution](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-5) (1 hour, then quarterly): One channel is one algorithm change away from an empty calendar. But every channel has its own guests, fees and rules, and the wrong one discounts your best nights.
6. [Marketing And Sales](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-6) (1 hour a month): No time for content, and past guests forgotten the day they check out. Your cheapest next booking is someone who already stayed.
7. [Revenue Management](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-7) (20 minutes a week): Prices left on autopilot, or panic-discounted. A calm weekly check beats both.
8. [Scale Up: Win More Homes](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-8) (15 minutes per owner): For property managers and co-hosts: owner pitches all sound the same. Show the owner their home and their guests, not your logo.
9. [Guest Experience](https://strbooster.com/playbook#step-9) (30 minutes to set up): The same twenty questions, every day, at every hour. Fast, warm, accurate replies are what five-star reviews are made of.

## Questions

### What is the STR AI Journey?

The STR AI Journey is a free, nine-step system for running a short-term rental business with Claude. Each step names one problem, gives you a prompt to copy and a Claude skill to download, and builds on the step before it: set up your business brain first, then brand, guests, listings, channels, marketing, pricing, owners and guest experience.

### Is it really free?

Yes. The journey, the prompts, the files and the emailed playbook are free, and there is nothing to buy. You do not need to sign up to use anything on this page.

### What order should I follow?

Go in order. Step 1, the business brain, gives Claude your goals, numbers and rules, and every later skill reads it. Property managers who want more homes can jump to step 8 once steps 1 to 3 are done.

### How long does the journey take?

Step 1 takes about 45 minutes, once. Most other steps take 15 to 60 minutes to set up, then a few minutes each week or month to run.

### How do I install a Claude skill?

Download the skill’s .zip without unzipping it. In Claude, open Settings, find Skills and upload the .zip. Then ask for the job in plain words and Claude uses the skill on its own.

### Are these skills free?

Yes. Every skill is free to download, use and change. There is no sign-up, and nothing is for sale.
